loopConfig.description: loop controller config, relative to this file: verify records, code trees, iteration tags, --record

adapters.description: instance modules exporting `adapters` ({ name: (args, ctx) => measurement }), relative to this file

gate.description: controller gate the verdict is recorded on (default quality)

tagPrefix.description: iteration tags (default: the loop config's tagPrefix, else iter-)

notMeasured.description: verdict when a blocking metric is not measured (default not-met)

tagPattern.description: git tag glob of releases, for per-release cadence (e.g. rc-*)

gate.description: the gate line or decision this metric encodes

adapter.description: built in: verify, registry, table, feedback, real-signals, vitest-log, visual; or an instance adapter

direction.description: higher: value >= threshold passes; lower: value <= threshold; bool: value === threshold (default true)

k.description: derived: band = k x the standard error the adapter reports

since.description: derived (feedback): first iteration of the persona retest spread

personaSd.description: derived (feedback): persona score sd given instead of estimated

why.description: every metric says why its band is what it is, including none

blocking.description: true: decides the verdict; false: informative

veto.description: a failure means not met whatever else holds; implies blocking; ignores the noise band
